title: Ukwihangana kw'ubugingo bubabaye
intro: Mu nkuru z’amateka, hari umuntu witwa ko ari we wihangana. Uyu muntu yageragejwe no gutakaza ihumure ryose ryo mu isi, nyamara yakomeje kuba umugaragu w’Umuremyi w’indahemuka. Mu myaka myinshi y’ingorane n’uburwayi bw’umubiri, umutima w’uyu muntu wakomeje gukomera mu kwizera, utanga urumuri rw’ibyiringiro ku bantu bose bahura n’ingorane.
clues: Nari umugaragu w’Imana wiyeguriye Imana, mfite ubutunzi bwinshi, abana benshi, n’ubuzima bwiza.
Ubuzima bwanjye bwarahindutse ubwo namburwaga ubutunzi bwanjye n'umuryango wanjye, binsigira nta kindi uretse ukwizera kwanjye gusa.
Narwaye indwara iramba kandi ibabaza cyane, yagerageje ubushobozi bw'umuntu bwo kwihangana.
Mu mibabaro yanjye yose, nanze kwitotombera Umwami wanjye, ndetse n'igihe umwanzi yageragezaga kunjyana mu kwiheba.
Ubwo nahamagaraga Umwami wanjye, sinasabye ubutunzi, ahubwo nemeye gusa ko amakuba yari yankozeho.
Nabwiwe gukubita hasi n'ikirenge cyanjye, maze haturuka isoko y'amazi akonje yo gukiza umubiri wanjye no kumara inyota yanjye.
arabic: ٱرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ ۖ هَـٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌۭ وَشَرَابٌۭ
verse: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for a] cool bath and drink." (38:42)
